bands.name: tri
bands.source: mean |dz| to 8 neighbours on 1 km elevation

correlation.method: Spearman on 20000 random cells (seed 0); display diagnostic only — SDM screening uses background cells (variable_screening.csv).

limitations: Copernicus DEM is a surface model (DSM), not bare-earth.
Climate is a 1981-2010 climatology; it does not describe a specific observation year.
WorldCover 2021 is a single-date land-cover snapshot.
SoilGrids are model predictions (machine-learning soil maps), not measured profiles; uncertainty is high in mountains.
fcf, cmi_mean and npp may have no CHELSA future equivalent and are then excluded from projected SDMs.
